title: Private Berlin Tour for Groups - Quick Summary
items: **Choose private when the shape of the walk is the real question.** A specific theme, a start time that suits the group, a slower pace or wanting the walk to yourselves can justify it.

**Choose the free tour when a fixed central introduction is enough.** BerlinWalk lasts about 2 hours from the World Clock on Alexanderplatz towards Hackescher Markt, with the live calendar deciding the date and time.
**The public walk keeps its fixed historic-centre route.** It starts at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz, moves towards Hackescher Markt and lasts about 2 hours.
**A private walk does not stretch across the city.** Keep Charlottenburg Palace or the East Side Gallery as a separate part of the day rather than forcing them into the same two hours.
Use the Berlin Private Route Brief to see the real route and pick the version your group needs, then send your dates.
